current.title: Least squares intuition
current.body: The vertical distance from each point to the line is the residual. Squaring means big misses hurt much more than small ones, which is why a single outlier can drag the whole line.
current.lessonTitle: Fitting a line: least squares explained

conflicted.title: Gradient descent
conflicted.body: Learning rate too high = overshoot. Too low = takes forever.
conflicted.conflictingBody: Learning rate too high = overshoot and diverge. Too low = converges but very slowly. Try a schedule that decays over time.

offline.title: Feature scaling
offline.body: Standardise before gradient descent or the contours are elongated and convergence is slow.

readOnly.title: Instructor notes — exam scope
readOnly.body: The graded quiz covers modules 1 and 2 only. The capstone is assessed separately against the rubric in the syllabus.

otherNotes.title: Overfitting
otherNotes.body: More data usually helps more than a fancier model.

otherNotes.title: Confusion matrix
otherNotes.body: Precision = TP / (TP + FP). Recall = TP / (TP + FN). I keep mixing these up.
Ask in the forum about regularisation vs early stopping.
